content_sections.heading: About SAI
content_sections.text: The Sports Authority of India is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports (MYAS), registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, with the mandate of development and promotion of sports in the country. Its main objects are to achieve excellence in sports and to train and prepare sportspersons for international competitions, using sports infrastructure spread across the country and trained coaches. The Authority is substantially funded by the Government of India. This recruitment is issued by its Human Resources Division-II at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium Complex, New Delhi, and follows the guidelines in DoE O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.III A dated 09.12.2020.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for the engagement of services of retired persons, and only from Indian citizens who meet the essential educational qualification and the essential work experience given in Table-I of the notice. Applicants must be officers who worked under the Central Government, State Government or Union Territory Administrations and who: were holding the post of Junior Engineer or equivalent in their parent cadre/department; OR were holding at least 5 years of regular service in Level-5 in an engineering cadre (Rs. 25500-81100) (PB-1, Rs. 5200-20200 + GP 2800/-). Diploma in Civil Engineering from any recognized University or Institute; OR Diploma in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute; OR Degree in Civil Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE; OR Degree in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE. Masters' Degree in Civil Engineering from recognized University/Institute/AICTE; OR Masters' Degree in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE. Minimum one year experience in the various aspects of maintenance and constructions of civil infrastructure, preferably sports infrastructure works; OR Minimum one year experience in the various aspects of electrical works, preferably with electrical works in sports infrastructure. The age must be not exceeding 64 years as on the opening date for receipt of applications (the online application opens on 16 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Junior Engineer post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. The pension deducted is the pension fixed at retirement; if the employee has commuted part of the pension, the commuted portion is also deducted. The remuneration so fixed remains unchanged for the term of the contract. No annual increment, percentage increase or Dearness Allowance is allowed during the contract. Transport Allowance: Rs. 10,800/- per month during the contract, unchanged during the term of appointment. No TA/DA for joining the assignment or on its completion. No DA, accommodation, residential phone, personal staff, medical reimbursement, HRA, LTC or similar facilities are admissible. On official tour away from the place of posting, TA/DA is admissible under the rules for officers of equivalent level in SAI (Pay Grade Level 06). Income Tax or any other tax is deducted at source, and SAI will issue TDS/Service Tax Certificates as applicable. Leave: 1.5 days per month on a pro-rata basis in a calendar year; no remuneration for absence beyond 18 days in a year; unused leave lapses and is not carried forward. Tenure: 01 year or till the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, based on the performance review/requirement of SAI. The engagement is purely on contract and gives no right to claim regular employment in SAI or as a government employee.

content_sections.heading: SAI Junior Engineer Job Description
content_sections.text: Supervise, monitor and coordinate civil and electrical works related to construction, renovation, maintenance and upgradation of sports infrastructure and allied facilities. Prepare and scrutinize estimates, technical specifications, drawings and tender documents. Inspect works for quality control and compliance with prescribed standards. Verify measurements and bills. Coordinate with contractors, consultants and executing agencies. Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of works. Perform any other duties related to civil and electrical engineering works assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAI Junior Engineer
content_sections.text: Apply only online through the link https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Use a valid e-mail ID in the online form. It must stay active until the recruitment process is completed, and it cannot be changed once entered. Upload the self-attested documents listed below while submitting the application. Proof of date of birth: Aadhar Card/10th class mark sheet/12th class mark sheet Certificates of essential educational qualifications and experience Scanned copy of passport size colour photograph and signature Scanned copy of No Objection Certificate from the present employer, in case working in Central/State Government/Autonomous Organizations Latest Last pay drawn certificate Applications not in the prescribed format, incomplete or unsigned, or without a copy of the essential qualification certificates, experience certificates and mark-sheet of Board/University are liable to be rejected. SAI reserves the right to discard experience certificates that do not provide correct details.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be scrutinized/shortlisted on the basis of relevant experience and job description. Eligible candidates will be called for an interview at their own cost, and no TA/DA will be paid. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not mean a candidate will be called for interview. Selection will be made on the recommendations of a duly appointed Selection/Interview Committee. Candidature remains provisional at all stages and will be cancelled if, at any stage before or after the interview, a candidate is found not to meet any eligibility condition.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in SAI Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Junior Engineer, to be filled by engaging a retired person on a Last Pay Drawn Minus Pension basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the SAI Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: The online application opens on 16 November 2026 and the closing date for submission is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the SAI Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: Retired officers of the Central Government, State Governments or Union Territory Administrations who held the post of Junior Engineer or equivalent, or at least 5 years of regular service in Level-5 of an engineering cadre, can apply. Applicants must be Indian citizens.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for SAI Junior Engineer?
faq.answer: A Diploma in Civil or Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute, or a Degree in Civil or Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE. A Masters' Degree in Civil or Electrical Engineering is desired.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SAI Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age must be not exceeding 64 years as on the opening date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the SAI Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Last Pay Drawn Minus Pension (Pay Matrix Level 06, 7th CPC), fixed for the contract, plus a transport allowance of Rs. 10,800/- per month. No DA, HRA, LTC or increment is allowed.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for SAI Junior Engineer?
faq.answer: Apply only online through https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs, uploading self-attested documents including the latest Last pay drawn certificate. Applications by any other mode will be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SAI Junior Engineer?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted on relevant experience and job description, and eligible candidates are interviewed at their own cost. Selection is made on the recommendations of a Selection/Interview Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is the SAI Junior Engineer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on contract for 01 year or till the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to claim regular employment.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the SAI Junior Engineer interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are called for the interview at their own cost, and no TA/DA will be paid.
